title: Looking for feedback for Futbol Warriors ⚽️⚔️
author: sametnadav
selftext:
Hey everyone!  
  
I’m looking for feedback on the alpha of **Futbol Warriors**, a vibe coded game that mixes soccer with medieval combat.

Think two-minute, 11v11 matches with knights, mages, berserkers, etc. Pass, shoot and score... or fight and cut off limbs. It gets pretty chaotic 😅

**Play here:** [https://tesana.com/play/990ca7a8-7975-4238-9419-fab0788a21d4](https://tesana.com/play/990ca7a8-7975-4238-9419-fab0788a21d4)

I’d love your honest thoughts on the premise and gameplay. Does soccer mixed with combat appeal to you? Is the chaos fun? What feels frustrating, and what would make you want another match?

Thanks to anyone who gives it a try or shares their thoughts! Even a quick first impression would help me decide how to move forward.
